description: Return the full markdown of Mockzilla doc topics. Pass `topics` with one or more ids from `mockzilla_docs_topics`, or `category` to read a whole category in one call. A large request returns what fits and lists the rest in `remaining`: read those in a second call. A link to another topic reads as (topic `id`). Each topic carries `url`, its public page, to give the user; don't fetch it, the markdown is the same page.
name: mockzilla_docs_read
